paragraphs: Rabbi Yose bar Natan, in Rav’s time. Yesh Nochalin 121a and Nedarim 78a: he followed Rav Sheshet to Nehardea, did not find him, and followed him to Mechoza. The statement that he was in Rav’s time is incorrect, for Rav Sheshet was Rav Huna’s student, Rav Huna was Rav Yehudah’s student, and Rav Yehudah was Rav’s student. Shabbat 53a: Rav Assi bar Natan asked Rabbi Chiyya be-Rav Ashi; Rabbi Zeira then explained the ruling. At the end of HaRoeh, 62a, Rav Ashi explains what Isi bar Natan meant. All are one; see Ammi bar Natan above. Yuchasin made a separate section for each: Assi bar Natan, Isi bar Natan, Ashi bar Natan.
